## Recovered observations

70 points (from FC-4B) read by two readings made separately and reconciled (batch `curves-appc-b2`, rules `docs/CURVE-READING.md (2026-10-08)`). Values are SI; the printed-unit values and the pixel coordinates on the page image are kept beside them so every point can be checked against the scan. x_read_bound and y_read_bound are reading bounds in printed units: the largest change of value over the point's pixel interval on the piecewise map, plus the location error of the two lines around it (D-025; the global calibration residual is not added, see qa/<batch>/calibration-sensitivity.md for the affine difference); x_bound_si and y_bound_si are the same in SI. They are not standard deviations.

Both readings drawn on the page image (filled circles: Claude's reading; hollow squares: Codex's; bars: pixel bounds; the canonical reading of each panel is named in the batch review). Click to enlarge.

## Notes from the two readings

- Claude: Table 2-3 soil 6 gives 61.4 pcf at Dr 0; FC-12 (RC2 Loose) has markers at these stresses but is not this sheet alone; dilation all contraction; box geometry and shear rate not printed in App. C
- Codex: Geometry and rate missing; Dr is group range. AM-68-1 Vol. II, Fig. C-4B, printed C-13, PDF 127
